alerts.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued June 30 at 6:57PM CDT until June 30 at 10:00PM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
alerts.description:
FFWMAF

The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Jeff Davis County in southwestern Texas...
Southwestern Reeves County in southwestern Texas...

* Until 1000 PM CDT.

* At 657 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Balmorhea, Balmorhea Lake, Saragosa, Balmorhea State Park,
Toyahvale and Verhalen.

alerts.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued June 30 at 7:12PM CDT until June 30 at 8:15PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
alerts.description:
SVRAMA

The National Weather Service in Amarillo has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Armstrong County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southeastern Carson County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southwestern Gray County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Western Donley County in the Panhandle of Texas...

* Until 815 PM CDT.

* At 712 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 8 miles south of Groom to 5 miles north of Wayside,
moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to roofs, siding, and trees is possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Claude, Groom, Howardwick, Lake Mcclellan, Greenbelt Lake, and
Goodnight.
